inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home: There were 9 children in care; 2 infants, 1- 18 month old and 6-3 yr olds. The home had more children ages 18 months to 3 years old than what is allowed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home (26 TAC §747.1801)

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Non-walking: A crib was not available for one non-walking infant.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Non-walking (26 TAC §747.2305(1))

occurrences.finding: No Swaddling of Infant Unless Completed Sleep Exception Form on File: An infant was observed swaddled in a blanket while napping in a play yard. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: No Swaddling of Infant Unless Completed Sleep Exception Form on File (26 TAC §747.2328)

occurrences.finding: AP Must Place Infants in Face up Sleeping Position or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant: An infant was observed laying in a play yard swaddled and in a face down position. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Must Place Infants in Face up Sleeping Position or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant (26 TAC §747.2327(a))

occurrences.finding: Comply with Child-care Licensing Law and Rules: It was determined the primary caregiver provided Child Care Regulation with falsified training documents for CPR and First Aid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Comply with Child-care Licensing Law and Rules (26 TAC §747.207(9))

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers: The primary caregiver does not have current Pediatric First Aid Training and Pediatric CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1313(a))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required: As of 5/27/26, verification the required make-up training hours were completed has not been received. This deficiency is being recited.  The primary caregiver received 12.5 of the 30 clock hours of required annual training for the November 2024-Noveember 2024 training year. The caregiver will need to complete 17.5 clock hours of make-up training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness-Continuity of Care: As of 5/27/26, the required updates to the emergency preparedness plan have not been received. This deficiency is being recited. The emergency preparedness plan does not state how children will be cared for during the emergency.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness-Continuity of Care (26 TAC §747.5003(4))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness- Reunification Plan: As of 5/27/26, the required updates to the parent handbook have not been received. This deficiency is being recited. The emergency preparedness plan does not state how children will be reunited with parents once the emergency is over.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness- Reunification Plan (26 TAC §747.5003(5))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: As of 5/27/26, the required updates to the parent handbook have not been received. This deficiency is being recited.  The operational policies lacked the following information:  1. The plan to ensure physical activity occurs when the weather prevents outdoor play.  2. Parent's Rights  3. How parents may access Minimum Standards on-line, the Texas Abuse & Neglect phone number and the HHSC website.  4. Water activities offered.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §747.207(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: As of 5/27/26, the required updates children's records have not been received. This deficiency is being recited.  Of the four children's records evaluated, the following information was missing:  1. Two lacked the address for the emergency contacts.  2. All lacked permission for water activities.  3. One lacked the name, address and phone number of the child's doctor.  4. One lacked a shot record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement: As of 5/27/26, the required children's health statements have not been received. This deficiency is being recited. Of the four children's records evaluated, all lacked a health statement from the parent stating the child has been examined within the past year by the child's doctor. The statement must include the name and address of the doctor.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement (26 TAC §747.611(a))
